facts.fact: The ADEA peer review of September 2019 found no formal structures for data sharing among key education stakeholders in Zimbabwe, and recommended a data reporting and sharing platform.

The peer review reported that education data sit in different ministries and datasets, making a sector-wide report hard to produce, and recommended integrating education data into a consolidated annual report.
